publication.title: First theropod record from the marine Bathonian of Jaisalmer Basin, Tethyan coast of Gondwanan India
publication.journal: Rivista Italiana di Paleontologia e Stratigrafia

locality.name: PBDB collection 229089: "from a building stone quarry near Chandoo Village. This 8 m deep building stone quarry is located 23 km NE of the Jaisalmer town and 500 m south of Chandoo village on Jethwai-Kanod road"; also located "2 km SW of Joshianwala Gaon."

age.basis: PBDB assigns collection 229089 to Early Bathonian–Middle Bathonian with numeric bounds 168.2–165.3 Ma.
age.notes: Database-derived occurrence snapshot from Paleobiology Database reference 83820; not yet re-verified against the publication full text.

claims.summary: PBDB occurrence 1619806 records Averostra in collection 229089, linked by PBDB to reference 83820.
PBDB stores the original/identified name as Averostra indet. and the accepted name as Averostra.
